top_paper.title: RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning
top_paper.summary: RoboTok retrieves relevant human manipulation videos from the web using a latent motion space derived from 3D hand trajectories to improve robot policy training.

papers.title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Teacher-Gated On-Policy Distillation verifies teacher reliability per prompt via verifier-scored probes, routing to dense distillation or verifier-grounded reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency and accuracy.

papers.title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing
papers.summary: KnowChange uses vision-language models to guide flexible, diverse change data synthesis for improving change detection training.

papers.title: Unfold The World: Factorize 4D Properties in Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning
papers.summary: FactoSR improves vision-language model spatial reasoning by decomposing 3D and temporal recovery into factorized geometric sub-objectives optimized via reinforcement learning.

papers.title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
papers.summary: HarvestBench evaluates LLM agents in a farm simulation where they choose between harming animals at no cost or avoiding them for fuel, revealing price-sensitive and briefing-dependent kill rates across models.

papers.title: Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research
papers.summary: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved. We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-agent executors in a controllable and auditable human-in-the-loop workflow rather than introducing another autonomous agent. papers.title: Knowing What Not to Answer: Selective Non-Compliance in Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: KoNA evaluates vision-language models on selective refusal across mixed queries and improves compliance via targeted fine-tuning.

papers.title: Refuse without Refusal: A Structural Analysis of Safety-Tuning Responses for Reducing False Refusals in Language Models
papers.summary: Decomposing safety responses into refusal statements and rationales reveals that training on rationales alone reduces false refusals while preserving safety.

papers.title: The 2026 PNPL Competition: Word Classification and Efficient Cross-Subject Generalisation in LibriBrain100
papers.summary: The 2026 PNPL competition introduces cross-subject and within-subject word classification tracks using an expanded MEG dataset to advance non-invasive speech-decoding brain-computer interfaces toward clinical feasibility.

papers.title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons
papers.summary: UniMate is a unified diffusion transformer that generates articulated motion for arbitrary skeletons from text and rigged 3D assets without per-skeleton retraining, using topology-aware attention and a large curated motion dataset.

papers.title: One Editor, Many Edits: A Unified Training-Free Framework for Diverse Video Editing
papers.summary: EditVid is a unified training-free video editing framework that uses sparse causal memory, token injection, and soft latent blending to support both instruction-guided and subject-guided edits with high fidelity.

papers.title: Beneath the Surface of Chains-of-Thought: A Mechanistic Interpretation of Reasoning Operations in LLMs
papers.summary: Distinct reasoning operations in language models are geometrically separable in hidden representations, with structure emerging across layers and depending on contextual reasoning context.

papers.title: Training-Free Speech-Centric Omni Understanding with Frozen VLMs
papers.summary: TFO enables frozen vision-language models to perform speech-centric audio-visual understanding via modular transcript routing without retraining or architectural changes.

papers.title: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.summary: The study formalizes multi-agent LLM coordination via bilevel games and stochastic memory reflection, introducing a grounded evaluation gate and SRMA algorithm with convergence guarantees, validated on SWE-bench.

papers.title: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models
papers.summary: Audio-video diffusion models exhibit bidirectional semantic leakage through cross-modal attention pathways, which can be diagnosed via attention-derived signals and mitigated through inference-time alignment interventions.

papers.title: To See a World in a Living Context: Unified Indoor-Outdoor Urban World Generation
papers.summary: HoloWorld unifies indoor and outdoor 3D urban generation through a continuously updated cross-scale context that ensures coherent building-level correspondence and cross-block continuity.

papers.title: τ^τ-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
papers.summary: The τ^τ-bench benchmark evaluates coding agents on building real-world customer-service agents from business records, client requirements, and production APIs, revealing substantial gaps versus expert performance.

papers.title: Enoki: Efficient Multi-Level Hallucination Detection
papers.summary: Enoki is an open information extraction framework that unifies claim-level verification and span-level hallucination localization through shared relational facts, reducing resource use while improving detection accuracy.

papers.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.summary: ShallowStream uses shallow MLLM layers to build a lightweight streaming index, reducing latency while maintaining accurate video retrieval.

papers.title: AdaptVPR: Route-Aware Hard Positive Generation for Robust Visual Place Recognition
papers.summary: AdaptVPR improves visual place recognition by generating verified synthetic same-place images with diverse appearance changes to train more robust models.

papers.title: Ask Before You Optimize: Dynamic Pre-Formulation Clarification for Interactive Optimization
papers.summary: OR-Clarify benchmarks clarification before optimization modeling, and InterOPT guides agents to ask questions or stop based on missing formulation-critical details.

papers.title: Motion-Omni: End-to-End Joint Speech and Full-Body Motion for Spoken Dialogue
papers.summary: Motion-Omni is an end-to-end framework that jointly generates spoken dialogue and full-body co-speech motion from shared hidden states, using scalable pseudo-labeling and a unified evaluation protocol to achieve real-time, aligned responses.

papers.title: When Models Edit Too Much: On the Fidelity of Minimal Code Edits
papers.summary: Large language models frequently over-edit code during repair, but preservation instructions and reinforcement learning can improve edit fidelity without sacrificing correctness.

papers.title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
papers.summary: MaxKernel is a multi-agent system that automates TPU kernel development through collaborative, autonomous, and graph-based search paradigms, achieving expert-level performance on diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
papers.summary: RISE improves language model post-training by recursively generating dense token-level supervision from the model's own reinforcement learning trajectory via self-extrapolation, avoiding external teachers.

papers.title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference
papers.summary: Quantized recurrent inference suffers from state write-back rules that suppress small updates, but error feedback and residual memory restore accuracy without retraining across GRU and LSTM architectures.

papers.title: Don't Drop Dropout: Optimizing Layer Sparsity for Efficient LLM Training and Inference
papers.summary: Layer dropout improves large language model training efficiency and enables faster inference via early exit and speculative decoding without sacrificing accuracy.

papers.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos
papers.summary: Adapting a single-object 3D generative prior to multi-view observations enables scalable compositional mesh reconstruction of densely cluttered scenes with severe occlusion.

papers.title: Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization
papers.summary: GAPO adaptively adjusts importance-sampling clipping thresholds based on rollout advantage to preserve stronger gradient signals from low-success groups in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

papers.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
papers.summary: Two large-scale search agents are trained via a multi-stage pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning against live search, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results on complex web benchmarks through rigorous trajectory filtering and inference-time context management.
